candidates.summary: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-13 Dragon docked with the International Space Station at 7:05 p.m. EDT, seven hours and 55 minutes after launch—the fastest launch-to-docking by a U.S. spacecraft in ISS history. The crew consists of NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney, Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk and Russian cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov.
candidates.title: Crew-13 reaches space station in record U.S. transit time

candidates.summary: Hurricane Rachel strengthened into a Category 3 storm off Mexico’s Pacific coast. The National Hurricane Center reported maximum sustained winds of 120 mph at 8 p.m. Mountain time, with the center about 235 miles south of the southern tip of Baja California. No coastal watches or warnings were in effect, but life-threatening surf and rip currents were expected along parts of Mexico’s coast.
candidates.title: Hurricane Rachel strengthens to Category 3 off Mexico

candidates.summary: The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations center said it received a third-party report that an unidentified tanker was struck by an unknown projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire. The crew was reported safe; the vessel’s damage and any environmental impact were not immediately known, and no party claimed responsibility.
candidates.title: Tanker catches fire after reported strike in Strait of Hormuz
